sentences.text: Incubators and other programs
A plain comparison of incubators and other kinds of startup program, each described from named public sources, with no program ranked.
This page sets two categories of support side by side on the same questions.
Each statement about a category names a public source, and the sources are listed at the end of the page.
Where WE sits
WE is a digital incubator for SaaS.
A founder brings an idea or an early product.
WE brings a method, a way of steering a team, and dedicated team seats that work only on that company.
The program is fully remote, so nobody relocates and there is no office to visit.
WE is probably not the right fit if
You need a physical office, on-site staff or in-person work.
WE is fully remote.
You are looking for money rather than a team.
WE makes no promise of funding.

Dedicated team or agency
A plain comparison of a dedicated team and an agency, each described from named public sources, with no company ranked.
This page sets two categories of support side by side on the same questions.
Each statement about a category names a public source, and the sources are listed at the end of the page.
Where WE sits
The seats are offshore, they scale up or down by notice, and WE manages the team and any subcontractors on the founder's behalf.
A seat is not a fixed promise of output.
WE steers the work, and what ships depends on the scope and on your decisions.
WE is probably not the right fit if
You want WE to run your product in production or to provide round-the-clock support.
A dedicated team
A seat is one dedicated place on your company's team.
It is filled by an offshore specialist who works on your company and on nothing else.
You want a team and a method to carry out the work, and you will keep ownership of the direction.
You decide where the company is going.

Where WE sits
WE is a digital incubator for SaaS companies: dedicated offshore team seats steered by WE, fully remote, with no promise of funding.
WE is probably not the right fit if
Your idea is not a software-as-a-service product.
You want WE to run your product in production or to provide round-the-clock support.
Build
From the blueprint altitude, the team draws what a first release must do, cuts the scope to that, and builds it in reviewed cycles.
Build starts from a problem you have tested.
You want a team and a method to carry out the work, and you will keep ownership of the direction.
You can make decisions for the company and join a review at each cycle.
